title: AnyPS5 Short
notes: Facts as in the main episode's script.json (checked 2026-10-09). Narration: ElevenLabs voice 'Eric' via vidIQ.

lines.text: PS5 games on a PC, with no emulator.
lines.say: PS5 games on a PC, with no emulator.

lines.text: This free tool rewrites the game itself into a Windows program.
lines.say: This free tool rewrites the game itself into a Windows program.

lines.text: The PS5's processor already speaks your PC's language.
lines.say: The PS5's processor already speaks your PC's language.

lines.text: It just swaps in its own versions of Sony's system libraries.
lines.say: It just swaps in its own versions of Sony's system libraries.

lines.text: One game works so far: 60 frames per second on a GTX 1050 Ti.
lines.say: One game works so far: sixty frames per second on a G.T.X. ten-fifty T.I.
Sixteen thousand GitHub stars in two months.

lines.text: It's called AnyPS5. Bring your own games, and only download it from GitHub.
lines.say: It's called Any PS5. Bring your own games, and only download it from GitHub.
